overrides.rationale: The bundled LICENSE is the permissive zlib license although the package manifest omits its SPDX field.

The published package omits the license file and SPDX field. The version-scoped pnpm patch restores the unmodified MIT LICENSE from npm gitHead 1b1f6dfdba6a775410508884097443d35c9a8690; see docs/runbooks/dependency-licenses.md.
